name: hive-monorepo
description: Self-hosted AI infrastructure: IAM, HiveMem memory service, model router, and the unified Hive console.
author: ChefTaco

scripts.bootstrap: for d in packages/hive-release services/hive-router services/hive-iam services/hive-mem/ts-core services/hive-mem/sdks/typescript services/hive-skills packages/hive; do (cd "$d" && npm ci) || exit 1; done && npm run hooks:install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/hive-release run typecheck && npm run typecheck:router && npm run typecheck:iam && npm run typecheck:memory-ts && npm run typecheck:skills && npm run typecheck:launcher && npm run typecheck:model-e2e
scripts.build: npm run build:router && npm run build:iam && npm run build:memory-ts && npm run build:skills && npm run build:launcher
scripts.test: npm run test:router && npm run test:iam && npm run test:audit && npm run check:openapi && npm run test:memory-ts && npm run test:skills && npm run test:release-manager && npm run test:launcher && npm run test:upgrades && npm run release:manifest:check && npm run test:suite
scripts.test:audit: node --experimental-strip-types --test scripts/audit-deployments.test.ts scripts/service-manifest.test.ts scripts/hive-doctor.test.ts scripts/hive-backup.test.ts scripts/dev-hive.test.ts scripts/hive-deploy.test.ts scripts/hivemem-token.test.ts scripts/architecture-boundaries.test.ts scripts/release-config-hardening.test.ts scripts/model-e2e.test.ts scripts/fresh-npm-e2e.test.mjs scripts/published-release.test.mjs scripts/candidate-registry.test.mjs scripts/deploy-npm.test.ts && python3 scripts/npm-deploy-host.test.py
scripts.audit:production: npm --prefix packages/hive-release audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix services/hive-router audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix services/hive-iam audit --workspace @hivemagnus/hive-iam-server --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix services/hive-iam/apps/iam-core audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix services/hive-iam audit --workspace @hivemagnus/hive-iam-sdk --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix services/hive-mem/ts-core audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix services/hive-skills audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix packages/hive audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.scripts:check: bash -n scripts/*.sh services/hive-iam/scripts/*.sh services/hive-iam/apps/iam-core/scripts/*.sh services/hive-mem/scripts/*.sh services/hive-router/scripts/*.sh services/hive-skills/scripts/*.sh scripts/suite/*.sh
scripts.test:webhook-sdks: npm run build:memory-ts && npm --prefix services/hive-mem/sdks/typescript run build && node --test scripts/hivemem-webhook-sdk.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:model: npm --prefix services/hive-mem/sdks/typescript run build && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/model-e2e.ts
scripts.test:suite: bash scripts/suite/controller.test.sh && node --test scripts/suite/skills-integration.test.mjs scripts/suite/existing-products-archive.test.mjs && bash scripts/suite/console.test.sh && bash scripts/suite/preflight.test.sh && bash scripts/suite/status.test.sh && bash scripts/suite/initialize.test.sh && bash scripts/suite/initialize-distributed.test.sh && bash scripts/suite/initialize-migrations.test.sh && bash scripts/suite/initialize-full.test.sh && bash scripts/suite/initialize-custom.test.sh && bash scripts/suite/native-initialization.test.sh && bash scripts/suite/integrity-host.test.sh && bash scripts/suite/input-artifacts.test.sh && python3 scripts/suite/interactive.test.py && bash scripts/suite/external-inference.test.sh && node --test scripts/suite/browser-rehearsal.test.mjs scripts/suite/check-data.test.mjs
